newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Citibank launches guaranteed-cap funds in Asia.
newsitem.headline: Citibank launches guaranteed-cap funds in Asia.

text.p: Citibank said on Friday it had launched a range of capital-guaranteed index-linked mutual funds in Asia.
Under the new CitiLink Guaranteed Portfolios, investors have a choice of four funds linked respectively to United States, Japan, Europe, and Asia (excluding Japan).
There is also a fifth fund in the family -- the "Best of Markets" fund. Returns of the fund are linked to the top three performing markets of the above four.
The final return of each fund will be linked to its market's appreciation between July 16, 1997 and July 13, 1998. The "Best of Markets" return will be measured over a two year period.
At the end of the investment periods, should markets have suffered a loss, investors can still redeam their investments at a minimum guaranteed value of US$1,000 per unit.
The Citilink funds will be available in selected Citibank locations in Asia, and Hong Kong branches will begin marketing the funds on Saturday.
